info-header.description: This desklet requires a running AutarkTrade.

server-host.tooltip: IP or hostname, e.g. 192.168.178.100 or localhost

server-port.tooltip: Default: 8080 (HTTP). With HTTPS on it is only used to fetch the certificate when pairing.

api-key.tooltip: From AutarkTrade → Settings → ESP32 Display → Generate key. Works even with the password gate enabled.

use-https.tooltip: Talks to AutarkTrade over HTTPS and trusts only the server certificate you paired below. Without it the API key and your account data travel unencrypted. The port above (8080) is still used to fetch the certificate when pairing.

ca-fetch.tooltip: Fetches the AutarkTrade CA over http://host:port/api/esp32/ca and shows its SHA-256 fingerprint below.

ca-pending.tooltip: Must match Settings › General › HTTPS in the AutarkTrade web app. Only then confirm.

ca-confirm.tooltip: Stores the certificate (0600) next to the desklet settings. From then on only this certificate is trusted.

ca-paired.tooltip: Empty = not paired. If the server certificate changes, pair again with the two buttons above.

show-realized-pnl.tooltip: Shows the already realized PnL of the open position (e.g. funding fees)

show-bots.tooltip: Shows running Pionex bots in a dedicated section (PnL/margin in the respective coin, e.g. SOL for Coin-M)
